name: PIP Joint Dislocation
definition: Dislocation of the proximal interphalangeal joint, most often dorsal, with possible volar-plate, collateral-ligament or central-slip injury.

investigations.principle: Radiographs are required before/after reduction when feasible and to assess fracture.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when soft-tissue, neural, marrow, occult injury, infection or other condition-specific questions require it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Anguli-Sandhi displacement phenotype may be documented after modern reduction.

patientEducation.summary: Dislocation of the proximal interphalangeal joint, most often dorsal, with possible volar-plate, collateral-ligament or central-slip injury.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for major trauma, acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
